articles.title: Surprise! These Medieval Graves Weren't Family Graves After All
articles.summary: Scientists tested DNA from 142 people buried together in medieval Sweden. Most weren't related! In one grave, a woman had walked a famous pilgrimage route thousands of kilometers.

articles.title: CERN Is Taking Apart the World's Biggest Atom Smasher
articles.summary: The Large Hadron Collider is a 27-km ring under Europe. Workers just started removing 28 giant magnets to install new ones that are 40% stronger. The upgrade takes years.

articles.title: James Webb Telescope Snaps a Huge Photo of a Star Nursery
articles.summary: The James Webb Space Telescope released one of its biggest images ever: a star-forming cloud 1,000 light-years away. It hides the tiniest brown dwarfs ever found — some only twice the mass of Jupiter.
